elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added language expressly applies “Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement” and upon termination of a Party’s participation.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause requires transition assistance for not less than 90 days, but does not provide a six-month assistance period or six-month cap.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no rates or payment provision for transition assistance.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The other Parties must export and deliver within 30 days all data and information belonging to, supplied by, or held or processed on behalf of the affected Party.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: No required format, including a standard machine-readable format, is specified.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: The clause imposes neither a deletion obligation nor a certification requirement.
